description: Preregistered finite census of behavioral equivalence families for tree, hierarchy, routing, temporal segmentation, control, recursion, and relational structure in the processed Tafazoli snapshot.

status_definitions.TESTABLE: The processed snapshot can screen the declared predictive fingerprint under frozen controls; this does not identify a biological implementation.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Only part of the defining fingerprint is observable in the processed snapshot, so the family cannot receive a complete test.
status_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Variables required to distinguish the family are absent from the processed snapshot and no surrogate score is permitted.

families.observable_fingerprint: A fixed linear state transition predicts held-out latent trajectories without discrete routing boundaries.
families.required_observations: Session-local D1 and D3 latent trajectories with nonoverlapping anchors and whole-trial folds.

families.observable_fingerprint: Axis-aligned splits select leaf-specific linear dynamics and beat a matched flat transition after topology cost.
families.required_observations: Held-out latent states sufficient to fit train-only split thresholds, leaves, and leaf regressors.

families.observable_fingerprint: A complexity-penalized sparse oblique split improves held-out leaf-specific dynamics over axis-aligned and flat controls.
families.required_observations: Train-only selection from a frozen sparse direction dictionary and untouched outer-test trajectories.

families.observable_fingerprint: Probabilistic gates mix leaf experts and improve predictive density beyond hard-tree and flat baselines.
families.required_observations: Held-out latent trajectories and train-only temperature, depth, and expert selection.

families.observable_fingerprint: Nested probabilistic gates route observations to local experts with a held-out likelihood gain after search cost.
families.required_observations: Outer-test latent trajectories and fully train-frozen gates, experts, depth, and regularization.

families.observable_fingerprint: A finite switching state-space model improves held-out dynamics after state-count and transition penalties.
families.required_observations: Session-local time series long enough for train-only discrete-state inference and frozen outer prediction.

families.observable_fingerprint: A tree-organized recurrent switching model shares statistical strength while preserving predictive state boundaries.
families.required_observations: Held-out session trajectories supporting a matched flat-rSLDS versus tree-rSLDS comparison.

families.observable_fingerprint: Sparse branch activation predicts path usage, latency, throughput, energy, and branch-specific causal effects.
families.required_observations: Actual active paths, nonoverlapping causal latency, throughput, energy, and selective branch perturbations.

families.observable_fingerprint: Geometric-duration latent states improve predictive density over a matched fixed linear model.
families.required_observations: Ordered session-local latent trajectories with train-only state-count selection.

families.observable_fingerprint: Explicit non-geometric state durations improve prediction beyond an HMM with matched complexity.
families.required_observations: Longer independent sequences with enough state entries to estimate held-out duration laws.

families.observable_fingerprint: Nested latent states explain multiscale segmentation beyond a flat state model.
families.required_observations: Independent multiscale sequences with enough repeated nested transitions to identify hierarchy depth.

families.observable_fingerprint: Variable-order history contexts beat fixed-order Markov predictors after context-tree description length.
families.required_observations: Ordered state or quantized latent sequences with train-only context pruning and frozen outer scoring.

families.observable_fingerprint: Initiation sets, policies, and termination conditions predict reward-linked temporally extended actions.
families.required_observations: Actions, rewards, goals, initiation sets, option terminations, and success or failure labels.

families.observable_fingerprint: Fallback, sequence, and condition nodes predict goal-conditioned action selection and recovery.
families.required_observations: Goals, actions, condition outcomes, success or failure, and recovery transitions.

families.observable_fingerprint: Task decomposition and ordering constraints predict goal-conditioned execution traces.
families.required_observations: Explicit tasks, subtasks, goals, operators, ordering constraints, and execution success.

families.observable_fingerprint: Variable-depth nesting obeys last-in-first-out suspension and exact caller-state resumption.
families.required_observations: Variable nesting depth, call and return events, stack contents, and caller-state resumption.

families.observable_fingerprint: A stable ultrametric or dendrogram geometry generalizes across sessions and subjects.
families.required_observations: Comparable units or representational objects across sessions plus independent stability and perturbation tests.

families.observable_fingerprint: A tree-structured dependency graph predicts simultaneous multivariate observations out of sample.
families.required_observations: Simultaneous neuron-level population samples rather than a stitched pseudopopulation.
